scenario_summary: Customer needs to access her account without her usual device and lacks login credentials or order information to process a requested refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Tanisha Jefferson and I'm 66. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello, Ms. Jefferson. I understand how frustrating it is to be locked out of your account, especially when you're away from your usual devices. I would be happy to help you with that refund, but for your security, I must verify your identity before we can access or modify any account details. Could you please provide your full billing address and the last four digits of the credit card used for the purchase?
Oh, that makes sense. My billing address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield, and the card ends in 4492.

Thank you, Tanisha. I've located your account using those details. To ensure I'm speaking with the account holder, our security policy requires one final verification step: I have just sent a temporary six-digit security code to the mobile number ending in 8821 that we have on file. Could you please read that code back to me?
Wait, that's my old landline number, I can't receive texts there. Is there any other way? I really need this refund processed today.

I apologize for the inconvenience. Since that number is a landline, I cannot send a text code there. Under our 'Account Recovery and Security' policy, if a customer cannot verify via the registered contact method, I must escalate this to our Account Security Team. They have specialized tools to perform identity verification through alternative means, such as reviewing recent transaction history or shipping addresses.

I have successfully created an escalation ticket for you, reference number #88291. A specialist will contact you within 24 hours to finalize the verification and process your refund request. Is there anything else I can assist you with while I have this ticket open?
No, that's all. Thank you for explaining why you couldn't just do it right now, I appreciate the help.

escalation_reason: Customer could not complete multi-factor authentication via the registered mobile number, requiring manual identity verification by the Account Security Team.
